metadata.warning: This file contains deterministic test-only Ed25519 key material for public test vectors. It must never be used for production signing.
metadata.vectorProfile: Stage 1 XNTD-to-XXXL Gateway fixed-width custom big-endian signed payload encoding
metadata.encoding: Every signed field is exactly 32 bytes. Unsigned integers are uint256 big-endian 32-byte words. Ethereum addresses are 20 bytes left-padded with zero bytes to 32 bytes. Optional fields are zero-filled, never omitted.

guardianSignature.warning: Deterministic test-only Ed25519 vector material. Never use this seed outside public test vectors.

invalidVectors.description: routeId and sourceChainId are swapped in the encoded message.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Message hash must not match the canonical field-order hash.

invalidVectors.description: deadlineOrFinalityBlock is omitted instead of being included as a zero-filled 32-byte field.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: All 19 fields are mandatory; unused optional fields must be zero-filled, not omitted.

invalidVectors.description: messageNonce is omitted instead of being included as a zero-filled 32-byte field.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: All 19 fields are mandatory; unused optional fields must be zero-filled, not omitted.

invalidVectors.description: burnedAmount is encoded as ASCII decimal string bytes instead of uint256 big-endian 32-byte word.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Amounts must be uint256 big-endian 32-byte words, never decimal strings.

invalidVectors.description: sourceChainId is 2 instead of Ethereum mainnet chainId 1.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Immutable Stage 1 route requires sourceChainId = 1.

invalidVectors.description: sourceToken is not the configured Ethereum XNTD token address.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Immutable Stage 1 route requires the exact configured sourceToken.

invalidVectors.description: sourceBurnTxHash differs from the verified Ethereum burn transaction.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: canonicalEventKey/evidence binding must match the verified source burn tx hash.

invalidVectors.description: sourceBurnEventIndex differs from the verified Ethereum burn event index.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: canonicalEventKey/evidence binding must match the verified source burn event index.

invalidVectors.description: sourceBlockNumber differs from the finalized Ethereum source block.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Finality evidence must bind the exact sourceBlockNumber.

invalidVectors.description: sourceBlockHash differs from the finalized Ethereum source block hash.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Finality evidence must bind the exact sourceBlockHash.

invalidVectors.description: canonicalEventKey does not match the canonical event key preimage.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: canonicalEventKey must equal keccak256(sourceChainId || sourceToken || sourceBurnTxHash || sourceBurnEventIndex).

invalidVectors.description: x1RecipientHash does not match the supplied raw 32-byte x1RecipientBytes.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: x1RecipientHash must equal keccak256(x1RecipientBytes).

invalidVectors.description: Invalid raw recipient bytes supplied outside the signed payload.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: x1RecipientBytes must be exactly 32 bytes and non-zero.

invalidVectors.description: Invalid raw recipient bytes supplied outside the signed payload.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: x1RecipientBytes must be exactly 32 bytes.

invalidVectors.description: Invalid raw recipient bytes supplied outside the signed payload.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: x1RecipientBytes must not be 32 zero bytes.

invalidVectors.description: burnedAmount is zero.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: burnedAmount must be greater than zero.

invalidVectors.description: xxxlMintAmount differs from burnedAmount.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Stage 1 full-weight accounting requires xxxlMintAmount = burnedAmount.

invalidVectors.description: sourceChainWeightBps is 9999 instead of 10000.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Stage 1 full-weight accounting requires sourceChainWeightBps = 10000.

invalidVectors.description: mintToken is not keccak256('XXXL').
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Immutable Stage 1 route requires mintToken = keccak256('XXXL').

invalidVectors.description: routeId is not keccak256('ETHEREUM_XNTD_TO_X1_XXXL_STAGE_1').
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Immutable Stage 1 route requires the exact routeId.

invalidVectors.description: The message hash is computed with a wrong domainSeparator.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: domainSeparator must be derived from the exact protocol, version, target network, target mint core, and message family.

invalidVectors.description: targetX1NetworkId is 1002 instead of 1001.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Domain separator must bind the exact target X1 network and target mint core.

invalidVectors.description: targetMintCoreId differs from the configured mint core id.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Domain separator must bind the exact target X1 network and target mint core.

invalidVectors.description: A guardian signature is checked against the wrong messageHash.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Ed25519 signature must verify against the exact canonical messageHash.

invalidVectors.description: The valid signature is altered by flipping one bit.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Altered Ed25519 signature must fail verification.

invalidVectors.description: The signature is valid for a different messageHash, but invalid for this vector's canonical messageHash.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: A signature over any different messageHash must not authorize this canonical message.

invalidVectors.description: The same canonicalEventKey is submitted after it has already been processed.
invalidVectors.expectedRejectionReason: Processed burn registry must reject duplicate canonicalEventKey before minting.
